newsitem.title: JAPAN: Akiyama bid-only after merger news.
newsitem.headline: Akiyama bid-only after merger news.

text.p: Akiyama Inc's shares were bid-only in early Friday morning trade after the pharmaceuticals wholesaler said on Thursday it was planning to merge with prescription drug wholesaler Suzuken Co Ltd.
As of 0050 GMT, Akiyama's shares were bid-only at 815 yen after closing at 795 on Thursday.

In the merger which will take place on April 1, 1998, one Akiyama share will be exchanged for 0.32 of a Suzuken share, the two firms said in a joint statement. Akiyama will be dissolved as a result of the merger, they said.
The two firms, both of which are listed on the second section of the Tokyo bourse, have had a business-and-equity tie-up since February 1994.
